scenes.prompt:
Environment-only background photograph for a premium Etsy listing image (square), professionally art-directed advertising.
Campaign mood: Cosy, nostalgic autumn railway reverie—an inviting creative pause with gentle storybook warmth and premium editorial depth..
Palette: Burnished ochre, maple red, moss green, deep walnut, soft cream and muted charcoal, chosen to flatter crisp black-and-white line art..
Lighting: golden evening light; Warm late-afternoon window light, softened by long shadows and an amber autumn glow..
Scene: Cinematic walnut creative desk beside a softly blurred autumn window, with a restrained cluster of coloured pencils, a closed paint tin and a few unmarked ceramic dishes on the left. Deep warm background fall-off, burnished ochre and moss accents, with a generous uncluttered area on the right for the product.
Composition: keep the lower two thirds of the frame, centred as a clear, empty, softly lit surface with natural depth, where an object will be placed later. Keep the top area calm and darker for text added later.
Photographic and realistic: shallow depth of field, cinematic warm light, restrained premium styling, no clutter.
Do NOT include: colouring pages, colouring books, books, notebooks, sketchbooks, sheets of paper, printed pages, paper artwork, drawings, line art, illustrations, posters, frames, screens, text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks, people, hands, animals, any card-, page-, sheet-, book- or print-like rectangle, any mock product.

examples.purpose: Coloured example of a real page (marketing illustration only; the product is black-and-white line art).
examples.prompt:
Colour in this exact colouring-book page as a finished example for an Etsy listing image.
Keep every black line exactly as it is: do not add, remove, move, redraw or restyle any line, object, pattern or lettering, and keep the whole page with its white margins visible.
Fill the enclosed areas neatly, as if coloured with coloured pencils and felt-tip markers: harmonious, natural colours with gentle shading inside the shapes.
Colour mood: warm cosy autumn, Autumn feeling.
Output: a flat, straight-on image of the coloured page on white paper. No table, hands, pencils, shadows, frame, border, added text, signature or watermark.
